name: Tower Defense Simulator
creator: Paradoxum Games
redeem: Launch Tower Defense Simulator on Roblox and wait until you are standing in the lobby.
Click the Codes button, a Twitter/X bird icon on the lobby screen. It has moved between lobby updates, so check the left side first, then the top right.
Click the Enter Code Here box in the window that opens.
Type or paste the code exactly as written, including capital letters, and press Redeem.
notes:
Tower Defense Simulator is a co-op tower defense game from Paradoxum Games. Up to four players leave the lobby together for a map, then spend the cash they earn each wave placing and upgrading towers along the path so zombie hordes and bosses never reach the base. Finishing matches pays out coins and experience, which unlock new towers back in the lobby.

Codes are rare here and usually mark milestones, like the 2 million likes code in the current description. Recent codes give tower skins or crates instead of coins, and a skin code only works if you already own the tower it belongs to. Paradoxum shares new codes on its X account and Discord, and occasionally on the game page.

codes.reward: Mercenary Pursuit skin (needs the Pursuit tower)

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming Tower Defense Simulator codes?
faq.a: Skin codes need the tower they belong to. 2MILLION gives the Mercenary Pursuit skin, so you have to own the Pursuit tower for it to work.

faq.q: Do I have to join the Paradoxum Games group to redeem Tower Defense Simulator codes?
faq.a: No. Codes work without joining. Joining the Paradoxum Games group gives a separate perk: +$100 starting cash in matches.

faq.q: Where does Paradoxum Games post new Tower Defense Simulator codes?
faq.a: Paradoxum posts new codes on its X account and Discord, and sometimes in the game description. Codes usually mark milestones. For example, 2MILLION came out for the game's 2 million likes.
